title: WPMS/1887/2018 of Ashok Kumar Vs District Magistrate Haridwar AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1887 of 2018
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
 Mr. Abhishek Verma, Advocate,
present for the petitioner.
 Mr. K.N. Joshi, Deputy Advocate
General, present for the State/respondent
nos.1 & 2.
 The petitioner was one of the
applicants seeking allotment of a country
liquor shop in District Haridwar.
Admittedly, the petitioner has not been
allotted the country liquor shop.
 By means of present writ petition,
the petitioner is seeking a writ of
mandamus directing the respondents to
cancel the allotment of the country liquor
shop, which has been allotted to the
private respondent instead of the
petitioner.
 This writ petition is totally
misconceived as the petitioner has no right
for allotment of a liquor shop.
 Consequently, the writ petition
stands dismissed in limine.
